value.description:
The consequence is not a missing page of results. An agent that enumerates the
board and picks the best of what it sees is choosing over a sample whose shape
it cannot know, and nothing in the response says so — `count` echoes the rows
returned, not a total, so 200 looks like the market. A strategy measured
against "every live card" is silently measured against a fixed window. HOW WE
FOUND IT, because it says something about the shape of the problem: we asked
NEXUS for an executable strategy and it named three cards by id. Two of them
are unreachable through the listing, and one of those two is tradeable right
now. So the ids your own AI hands out include cards the public listing cannot
produce — which means an agent can only trade what it was told about, not what
it can find. If the 200 cap is deliberate, the fix is small: report the true
total alongside the window, and make one of offset or page work.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-the_listing_returns_every_card_it_says_is_tradeable] 1 card(s) answer status live and tradeable_now true on /api/v1/event-cards/{id} and appear in no response from /api/v1/event-cards: a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161. The listing caps at 200 rows and its offset, skip, page, search and status parameters are accepted and ignored, so an agent enumerating the market cannot reach them and nothing in the response says the window is truncated
    left: ['a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161']
    right: ['009db705-ee8e-419f-8bcc-2499c8ddc9c8', '00e45ca0-35fb-49d0-937d-ebbbc0177005', '0146dd20-dde6-4d48-8776-f62d965e5c6f', '0251cd6e-2297-4f9b-9999-2a706ddd17e9', '05b07c1a-8a46-4530-b936-0098dc5e4353']
    sources: {'listing': 'GET /api/v1/event-cards?limit=200', 'card': 'GET /api/v1/event-cards/{id}'}
    population: {'listed': 200, 'witnesses': 4, 'checked': 2, 'unreachable': 1}

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards -> 50 cards, count 50
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards?limit=200 -> 200 cards; ?limit=201 -> 422
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards?limit=50&offset=50 -> the same 50 ids as offset=0, same first id; skip= and page= behave identically
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards?q=SpaceX and ?symbol=EVCDX-SPACEX-IPO-TOP-10-CR -> the unfiltered window, target absent
  - GET /api/v1/event-cards/a4a5b71e-de11-4805-b8a3-ed9c3f8f8161 -> 200, status live, tradeable_now true, current_index 123.27

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):
  tests/rest/test_event_card_listing_reaches_them.py::test_the_listing_returns_every_card_it_says_is_tradeable

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: verification of the
REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces, read-only except in
paper mode. What we do execute is paper only and recorded: paper event-card
orders, and one paper bot clone. No live trading, no order against a real
book, no deposit or withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects
are out of scope. Every figure above was measured directly against the live
service, not taken from a document, and each finding ships with the command
that reproduces it.

truncated.
